title: Taiwan Stocks Post Record Jump as Jensen Huang Returns to Nvidia
summaryZh: 黃仁勳回任輝達執行長，台股盤中狂漲逾3300點創紀錄。
summaryHi: जेन्सेन हुआंग की एनविडिया में वापसी से ताइवान के शेयर बाज़ार में रिकॉर्ड उछाल।
summaryEs: El regreso de Jensen Huang a Nvidia dispara la bolsa de Taiwán a una subida récord.
summaryJa: ジェンスン・フアン氏のエヌビディアCEO復帰で、台湾株が過去最大の上げ幅を記録。
summaryKo: 젠슨 황의 엔비디아 CEO 복귀로 대만 증시가 사상 최대 폭으로 급등했다.
summaryEn: Taiwan's stock market made its biggest-ever points gain after Jensen Huang returned as Nvidia's boss.
paragraphs: Taiwan's share market posted its biggest-ever intraday gain in points on Tuesday, a day after Nvidia announced that Jensen Huang would return as chief executive with immediate effect. The Taiwan-born co-founder had stepped down less than two weeks earlier.

Huang resigned on November 12 following reports about his private life, including an alleged relationship with a Chinese businesswoman whom US intelligence officials suspected of spying for Beijing. The board of Nvidia voted unanimously on Monday to reinstate him, saying it had received input from senior US officials and was confident his return posed no national security risk. An independent committee is still investigating, and the company has created a new committee to oversee export controls.

Investors reacted quickly. Nvidia's shares closed up 31.5% in New York on Monday, and on Tuesday morning the Taiex surged by as much as 3,368.49 points, or 9.15%. In percentage terms, that was second only to a 9.39% jump in April 2025. The index also returned above 40,000 for the first time since November 18.

TSMC, which accounts for more than 40% of the total value of the market, hit its 10% daily limit at NT$2,230 and contributed roughly 1,600 points of the rise. Other major suppliers, including MediaTek, Hon Hai, Delta Electronics and ASE Technology, also hit their limits, as did more than 500 stocks across the main board and the over-the-counter market.
Dealers said the reinstatement of Huang had reassured investors and eased fears about the direction of AI development without his leadership.
Jensen Huang is back as the boss of Nvidia. Nvidia is a big American company. It makes computer chips for AI. Huang was born in Taiwan, and many people in Taiwan like him.
Huang left the company on November 12. There were news stories about his private life. Some people worried about safety. On Monday, the leaders of Nvidia voted to bring him back.
On Tuesday morning, the stock market in Taiwan went up very fast. The main index rose by more than 3,300 points. This was the biggest rise in points ever. The index went above 40,000 again.
TSMC is the biggest company in Taiwan. It makes chips for Nvidia. Its shares went up 10%. That is the most they can go up in one day. More than 500 other stocks also went up 10%.
People who buy and sell stocks said investors feel calm again. They were worried about AI without Huang. Now they feel better.

paragraphs: Taiwan's stock market had a record day on Tuesday after Nvidia said that Jensen Huang would return as its chief executive. The Taiwan-born businessman started the American chip company more than 30 years ago.

Huang resigned on November 12 after reports about his private life, including a relationship with a businesswoman who was suspected of spying for China. On Monday, the board of Nvidia voted to bring him back immediately. The board said it had talked to senior US government officials and believed his return was not a national security risk.

Nvidia's shares in New York jumped more than 31% on Monday. The next morning, the main index in Taiwan, the Taiex, rose by as much as 3,368 points, or about 9%. It was the largest rise in points during a single trading day in its history, and the index climbed back above 40,000.

TSMC, which makes the most advanced chips for Nvidia, rose 10% to NT$2,230, the maximum allowed in one day. Because the company is so large, it added about 1,600 points to the index. MediaTek, Hon Hai and more than 500 other stocks also hit their daily limits.
Dealers said the return of Huang had calmed investors who were worried about the future of AI without him.

這位在台灣出生的企業家在30多年前創立了這家美國晶片公司。
黃仁勳在11月12日辭職，起因是有關他私生活的報導，其中包括他與一名涉嫌為中國從事間諜活動的女商人的關係。
星期一，輝達董事會投票決定立即讓他回任。
董事會表示，已和美國政府高層官員談過，並認為他回任不會構成國家安全風險。
輝達在紐約的股價星期一大漲超過31%。
隔天早上，台灣的主要指數加權指數最多上漲3,368點，約9%。
這是史上單一交易日內點數漲最多的一次，指數也重新站上40,000點。
為輝達製造最先進晶片的台積電上漲10%至新台幣2,230元，達到一天允許的最大漲幅。
由於這家公司規模非常大，它為指數貢獻了約1,600點。
聯發科、鴻海及其他500多檔股票也都漲停。
交易員說，黃仁勳回任讓原本擔心沒有他之後AI前景的投資人安心下來。

paragraphs: Taiwan's equity market staged a historic rally on Tuesday, recording its largest intraday point gain ever after Nvidia abruptly reversed course and reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive. The Taiwan-born co-founder had resigned only twelve days earlier.

His departure on November 12 followed reports about his personal relationships, one of them allegedly with a Chinese businesswoman suspected by US intelligence officials of spying for Beijing. In a unanimous vote on Monday, however, the board of Nvidia concluded that Huang was the right person to lead the company. Directors said they had consulted senior US government officials and were satisfied that his return posed no threat to national security, although an independent investigation remains under way and a new committee will monitor compliance with export controls.

Markets responded with striking enthusiasm. Nvidia's stock soared 31.5% in New York, and the Taiex climbed as much as 3,368.49 points, or 9.15%, on Tuesday morning, a percentage gain surpassed only by the 9.39% rebound of April 2025. The benchmark reclaimed the 40,000 mark for the first time since November 18.

The rally was driven overwhelmingly by the semiconductor supply chain. TSMC, which represents over 40% of the capitalisation of the bourse, hit its daily ceiling of 10% at NT$2,230, single-handedly accounting for around 1,600 points. MediaTek, Hon Hai and Delta Electronics were also limit-up, as were more than 500 other listed companies.

According to dealers, the comeback of Huang dispelled anxiety about the trajectory of AI development in his absence, underlining how closely the fortunes of Taiwan are tied to a single American chipmaker.
sentZh: 在輝達突然改變立場、讓黃仁勳復任執行長後，台灣股市星期二上演歷史性大漲，創下史上最大盤中點數漲幅。
這位在台灣出生的共同創辦人僅在12天前才辭職。
他在11月12日離職，起因是有關他私人感情關係的報導，其中一段據稱涉及一名被美國情報官員懷疑替北京從事間諜活動的中國女商人。
然而，輝達董事會星期一一致投票認定，黃仁勳是領導公司的合適人選。
董事們表示，他們已諮詢美國政府高層官員，確信他回任不會威脅國家安全，不過獨立調查仍在進行，且將由一個新委員會監督出口管制的遵循情況。
市場反應熱烈得驚人。
輝達股價在紐約飆漲31.5%，加權指數星期二早上最多上漲3,368.49點，漲幅9.15%，這個百分比漲幅僅次於2025年4月的9.39%反彈。
這項基準指數自11月18日以來首次重回40,000點大關。
這波漲勢絕大部分由半導體供應鏈帶動。
占證交所市值超過40%的台積電觸及10%的單日漲幅上限，來到新台幣2,230元，單獨貢獻約1,600點。
聯發科、鴻海和台達電也漲停，另有超過500家上市公司同樣漲停。
據交易員表示，黃仁勳回歸消除了外界對他缺席時AI發展走向的焦慮，也凸顯出台灣的命運與一家美國晶片公司之間的連結有多麼緊密。

paragraphs: Few corporate decisions have moved the stock market in Taiwan as dramatically as the announcement by Nvidia on Monday that Jensen Huang would resume his role as chief executive. On Tuesday, the Taiex posted the largest intraday point gain in its history, underscoring the profound dependence of the island on the artificial intelligence boom.

Huang, who co-founded the company, had resigned on November 12 amid reports concerning his personal relationships, including an alleged link to a Chinese businesswoman whom US intelligence officials suspected of espionage. The board of Nvidia nevertheless voted unanimously to reinstate him with immediate effect, stating that senior US officials had been consulted and that his return posed no national security risk. An independent inquiry is continuing, and a dedicated committee has been established to oversee export controls.

The reaction was immediate. Nvidia's shares rallied 31.5% in New York, and the Taiex subsequently surged by as much as 3,368.49 points, or 9.15%, a proportional gain exceeded only by the 9.39% rebound recorded in April 2025. The index thereby regained the psychologically significant 40,000 threshold for the first time since November 18.

Semiconductor stocks dominated the advance. TSMC, which constitutes more than 40% of total market capitalisation, rose by its permitted daily maximum of 10% to NT$2,230, contributing approximately 1,600 points on its own. More than 500 other stocks, including MediaTek and Hon Hai, likewise reached their limits.

Dealers attributed the rally to restored confidence in the leadership of AI development. Nevertheless, the episode illustrates how vulnerable the market in Taiwan remains to events at one foreign company.
sentZh: 很少有企業決策能像輝達星期一宣布黃仁勳將重任執行長一樣，如此劇烈地撼動台灣股市。
星期二，加權指數創下史上最大的盤中點數漲幅，凸顯出台灣對人工智慧熱潮的高度依賴。
共同創辦公司的黃仁勳在11月12日辭職，當時有關於他私人感情關係的報導，包括他據稱與一名被美國情報官員懷疑從事間諜活動的中國女商人有所牽連。
儘管如此，輝達董事會仍一致投票讓他立即復職，並表示已諮詢美國高層官員，他的回任不會構成國家安全風險。
獨立調查仍在持續，公司也成立了專責委員會來監督出口管制。
市場反應立竿見影。
輝達股價在紐約大漲31.5%，加權指數隨後最多飆升3,368.49點，漲幅9.15%，這個比例漲幅僅次於2025年4月記錄的9.39%反彈。
指數因此自11月18日以來首次重回具有心理意義的40,000點關卡。
半導體股主導了這波漲勢。
占總市值超過40%的台積電上漲至每日允許的最大幅度10%，來到新台幣2,230元，單獨貢獻了約1,600點。
包括聯發科和鴻海在內的500多檔其他股票也同樣漲停。
交易員將這波漲勢歸因於市場對AI發展領導者重拾信心。
然而，這起事件也說明台灣股市對單一外國公司的動態依然相當脆弱。
